body:
## DM-269 evidence detail (worker)

### c1 criterion -> test map
DM-174 c1 -> humanFeedback.attribution.test.ts: 'recordHumanFeedback: ratings/rescue entries keep who, when and scope', 'no agent session speaks for a person' (orchestrator/worker/planner/reviewer/reader unauthorized), 'MCP metric tools: no agent speaks for a person', 'keeps S missing when no feedback exists'
- c2 -> spaceSignals.committedScope.test.ts 'committed scope after split, rename, rewording and deletion', 'trimming a committed ticket' (cannot raise A), 'scope across runs'
- c3 -> handoff.test.ts 'deriveHandoffChecks' (clarification passes, missing evidence/contract fails); spaceSignals.handoff.test.ts 'C deductions link to their records', 'coordination defects cite run records', 'measurement never blocks the lifecycle'
- c4 -> spaceSignals.normalization.test.ts 'S normalization: inherited versus ticket ratings', 'A normalization: zero, changed and unfrozen scope', 'C normalization: no handoffs and unavailable observations'.

DM-175 c1 -> verification.test.ts 'DM-175 c1: verification records' (+ failures/open outcomes, required evidence and cutoff, late reconciliation)
- c2 -> defects.test.ts provenance/invalid input, 'fold duplicates', 'reports grouped by judgement count once', observation window/withdrawal
- c3 -> verification.test.ts 'a later confirmed regression is a new dated input; accepted history stays' (hashes of attempts/reports/plans unchanged)
- c4 -> 'DM-175 c4: checked-in performance fixtures' (all four named fixtures, exact P inputs, F 59 / ungraded / P 100 / P 70).

DM-176 c1 -> efficiency.test.ts 'corrective share: denominator and causes' (retry count only a diagnostic), 'partial and unknown classification'
- c2 -> 'time and token actuals against the frozen baseline' (overhead once, no double charge), services/efficiency.test.ts getTicketEfficiency/getRunEfficiency
- c3 -> 'missing baselines and zero observations' (zero budget refused, no A on zero observations), 'partial telemetry and unsettled streams', 'cohort comparability'
- c4 -> efficiency.cohorts.test.ts research-vs-repair, approval-wait, cohort-inflation (three cutoffs).

DM-177 c1 -> rubric.grades.test.ts 'exact band boundaries and display rounding', 'seven equal base weights', 'invalid input is refused', 'identical reproduction'
- c2 -> 'a confirmed mandatory failure caps the grade at F', 'missing required verification stays ungraded'; spaceGrades.ticketGrade.test.ts from records
- c3 -> 'sparse examples are provisional or ungraded', 'one unknown input ... is missing, never 0 or 100' (effective weights)
- c4 -> 'explanations carry evidence, cutoff, normalization, baseline and caps', 'activity volume alone never raises a grade' (+ from records).

DM-178 c1 -> spaceGrades.aggregate.test.ts 'aggregate grades from the scope's raw measures' (acceptance/Fireguard not features, overhead kept, not a mean of letters)
- c2 -> 'a failed required or integrated outcome caps its level' (59 F despite A tickets), 'the cap survives later adoptions'
- c3 -> scorecards.snapshot.test.ts 'a report revision freezes its scorecard' (restart), 'a frozen scorecard stays as written' (later metrics/policy/adoption, stale-approval revision); scorecardPortability.test.ts export/import byte for byte; snapshot.golden.test.ts
- c4 -> 'legacy reports stay readable and ungraded', 'a dated reassessment keeps the approved grade and explains differences'.

DM-265 c1 -> metricsSummary.test.ts 'epic rows' (rows equal fresh getEpicGrade; raw totals equal scorecards)
- c2 -> 'totals and distribution' (raw measures, executed epics only, final/provisional/ungraded separately, no letter averaged, until excludes later epics)
- c3 -> 'unknown measures' (null + reason, coverage), 'on a legacy repository' (every epic ungraded, never zeros)
- c4 -> 'sprint trend', 'trend cohorts nobody sized', 'trend cohorts of work tickets', 'trend across policies' (comparable iff delta).

### c3 product fixes
npx oxlint on all touched files exit 0; npm run typecheck clean; 20 new test files 364/364 and 13 existing related files 397/397 pass. Fixes (each pinned): (1) DM-178 export verifies existing/outgoing scorecard -> conflict (finalizer.ts; 'DM-269 fix: export checks the scorecard file already there/it writes').
- (2) golden snapshot fixtures per policy (fixtures/snapshots/policy-v1/v2.json; snapshot.golden.test.ts). Degraded read of stored results NOT done (comment said 'consider').
- (3) import reports a differing scorecard (importer.ts changedReport; 'an import reports another scorecard for a report that already has one').
- (4) moved ticket: sprint roll-up dispatchedAt = earliest first dispatch of carried tickets (spaceGrades.ts; 'a ticket moved to a later sprint after a failed attempt': T 83.33, K 90, final 87.2 B instead of provisional 100 A).
- (5) re-sealed edits to ticket list, outcomes, sources, efficiency and graded timing fields refused (snapshot.ts parseScorecardSnapshot; 6 tests). Partial: timing fields not in any grade input (readiness, cycle/lead, elapsed windows) are not re-derived on import. Also pinned: one unreported attempt makes epic E/T/K missing (reason partial_coverage/partial_telemetry).
- (6) DM-265 hold: drops on any write via total_changes/data_version, refuses async/nested reads (observations.ts; observationsHold.test.ts incl. other-connection insert, same-connection epic deletion, 'refuses a read that returns a promise').
- (7) DM-267 review items in the summary: work-ticket cohorts with counts, unsized/empty -> cohort_unknown, cross_epic reason + previous epic/runNumber, gaps carry ticket key/title, no 100.0 gaps, reason text fixed (metricsSummary.ts, views.ts additive; metricsView.ts labels). Dashboard still does its own getRun/getPlan reads (DM-267 scope).
- (8) DM-175 defectOf withdrawal fallback; stateAt late resubmit + evidence rewind (defects.ts, verification.ts, performance.ts); same-call order and judgement-group cases pinned.
- (9) DM-176 refused agent active_ms under host placed spans no longer blanks T; actor-less run records no longer match each other; reprojection narrowed (perf2 6.4 s -> 161 ms, measured once, pinned structurally by projectTiming call counts); cohort-frozen-at-dispatch cases (adv4 a-h) pinned; fractional ms truncation pinned.
